name: Midou Kazuya
source:
Hobby: Reading, Teasing the protagonist

A 3rd year at Shoukei Academy.
His family runs a world famous business called the "Midou Group".
The charismatic type, a rational and intelligent guy with a cool personality.
He's great at everything besides cleaning and household chores.
